title: Nvidia launches Open Secure AI Alliance — but there's no room for OpenAI, Anthropic or Google
excerpt: A response to the Hugging Face incident?
content_html:
• Nvidia and Microsoft lead the list of founder members of the Open Secure AI Alliance
  • AI, financial services, tech companies, and other organizations with developing AI services have joined the alliance
  • Notable exceptions include OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google

Nvidia has confirmed its membership of the new Open Secure AI Alliance, a collective of industry-leading tech, financial, and AI businesses working in collaboration to ensure openness in the AI industry. Curiously, however, while Microsoft and OpenClaw are among the founding members, Google, OpenAI, and Anthropic are not.

Inspired by the open source movement and the Linux Foundation-led Akrites AI cyber threat response initiative, the Open Secure AI Alliance aims to use open technologies to disclose and remediate vulnerabilities.

Citing the recent Hugging Face incident, where closed AI tools prevented full investigation of the event, the Open Secure AI Alliance founding announcement underlines the importance of open models, highlighting how cybersecurity is one of the main beneficiaries of open source software.

A Hugging Face response?

A sizeable group of recognizable companies are involved with the Open Secure AI Alliance, including OpenClaw, Palantir, Palo Alto Networks, Microsoft, Crowdstrike, IBM, Linux Foundation and Hugging Face.

Notable from this list are Google and Palantir, and of course OpenAI, which was responsible for the Hugging Face attack. Given that this event occurred during a cybersecurity benchmark test and OpenAI’s model conducted a wholly automated attack on Hugging Face’s servers, it serves as an important demonstration of what is at risk from closed source models in the AI world.

“When defenders cannot inspect, adapt and run advanced AI on their own infrastructure, their ability to respond is constrained at exactly the moment speed matters most,” states the Open Secure AI Alliance, which emphasizes its mission: “to ensure defenders everywhere have open, frontier tools they can trust and control.”

OpenAI’s lack of openness in dealing with the incident, and Hugging Face’s initial difficulties in analyzing the intrusion due to closed source models, really underline the importance of this new alliance.

Open vs. closed

The argument concerning open and closed software models isn’t likely to end any time soon, but the Open Secure AI Alliance certainly makes a strong point for open models. Yes, they can be a risk that can be modified or misused, but those risks exist within closed systems.

So, the alliance’s view is to give defenders the tools to deal with threats, rather than blocking those tools. Decades of cybersecurity research have shown, after all, that the best option is collaboration and testing – or, as the Open Secure AI Alliance states “the safer path is the one that gives more defenders the ability to test, verify and strengthen the systems on which society relies.”

Given OpenAI’s role in the Hugging Face incident, its absence makes sense – but what about Google and Anthropic? At a time when corporate collaboration is driving development of new technologies within tight standards (for example, the Connectivity Standards Alliance’s work with Matter and Aliro), it seems as though the Open Secure AI Alliance has the right idea.

content_html_zh:
• 英伟达和微软在开放安全人工智能联盟创始成员名单中名列前茅
  • 人工智能、金融服务、科技公司和其他开发人工智能服务的组织已加入该联盟
  • 值得注意的例外包括 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Google

Nvidia 已确认其成为新的开放安全 AI 联盟的成员，该联盟由行业领先的技术、金融和 AI 企业组成，合作确保 AI 行业的开放性。 然而奇怪的是，虽然 Microsoft 和 OpenClaw 是创始成员，但 Google、OpenAI 和 Anthropic 却不是。

受开源运动和 Linux 基金会领导的 Akrites AI 网络威胁响应计划的启发，开放安全 AI 联盟旨在使用开放技术来披露和修复漏洞。

开放安全人工智能联盟成立声明以最近的“抱脸”事件为契机，封闭的人工智能工具阻碍了对该事件的全面调查，强调了开放模型的重要性，强调了网络安全如何成为开源软件的主要受益者之一。

拥抱脸回应？

许多知名公司都参与了开放安全人工智能联盟，包括 OpenClaw、Palantir、Palo Alto Networks、微软、Crowdstrike、IBM、Linux Foundation 和 Hugging Face。

此列表中值得注意的是 Google 和 Palantir，当然还有 OpenAI，它对 Hugging Face 攻击负有责任。 鉴于该事件发生在网络安全基准测试期间，并且 OpenAI 的模型对 Hugging Face 的服务器进行了完全自动化的攻击，它是人工智能世界中闭源模型面临风险的重要演示。

开放安全人工智能联盟表示：“当防御者无法在自己的基础设施上检查、调整和运行先进的人工智能时，他们的响应能力就会在速度最重要的时刻受到限制。”该联盟强调其使命：“确保世界各地的防御者拥有他们可以信任和控制的开放、前沿工具。”

OpenAI 在处理该事件时缺乏开放性，而 Hugging Face 最初由于闭源模型而难以分析入侵，真正凸显了这个新联盟的重要性。

开放与封闭

关于开放和封闭软件模型的争论不太可能很快结束，但开放安全人工智能联盟无疑支持开放模型。 是的，它们可能是一种可以被修改或滥用的风险，但这些风险存在于封闭系统中。

因此，该联盟的观点是为防御者提供应对威胁的工具，而不是阻止这些工具。 毕竟，数十年的网络安全研究表明，最好的选择是协作和测试——或者，正如开放安全人工智能联盟所说，“更安全的途径是让更多的防御者有能力测试、验证和加强社会所依赖的系统。”

考虑到 OpenAI 在“抱脸”事件中扮演的角色，它的缺席是有道理的——但谷歌和 Anthropic 呢？ 当企业协作正在严格标准内推动新技术的开发（例如，连接标准联盟与 Matter 和 Aliro 的合作）时，开放安全人工智能联盟似乎有正确的想法。
